HIA-Documentation-Sys · htmdoc-handoff
评估显式HTML编写交接元数据 / Evaluate explicit HTML authoring handoff metadata

版本身份 / Version identity
  显示工件契约0.1.0-draft；安装包为独立版本身份。
  Displays artifact contract 0.1.0-draft; package version is independent.

用法 / Usage
  htmdoc-handoff --input <safe-relative-json> [--out <safe-relative-json>]

参数 / Options
  -i, --input <safe-relative-json>
    必填，仅读取这一份元数据JSON。
    Required; read only this metadata JSON.
  -o, --out <safe-relative-json>
    可选输出文件；省略时将结果写stdout。
    Optional output file; omission writes the result to stdout.
  -h, --help
    输出帮助并退出0。 / Print help and exit 0.
  -v, --version
    输出工件契约版本并退出0。 / Print artifact contract version and exit 0.

路径与副作用 / Paths and effects
  路径相对调用目录且受safe-relative检查；输出文件由调用者显式选择。
  Paths are cwd-relative and checked as safe-relative; callers select output explicitly.
  运行读取所选元数据并可写所选结果文件；帮助不读取工作区。
  Runs read selected metadata and may write the selected result file; help does not inspect the workspace.

退出码 / Exit codes
  0 交接评估accepted、帮助或版本 / Accepted handoff, help or version
  1 交接评估refused或参数、读取、处理失败
    Refused handoff or argument, read or processing failure

离线完整说明 / Complete offline reference
  @hia-doc/htmdoc-runner/README.md
